def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

d='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpb0-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'

lib='''from collections import Counter, deque

def background(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def components(grid, color=None, bg=None):
    """4-connected components of cells of one color (all non-bg colors if color is None)."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if bg is None:
        bg = background(grid)
    seen, comps = set(), []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] != bg and (color is None or grid[i][j] == color) and (i, j) not in seen:
                c = grid[i][j]; q = deque([(i, j)]); comp = []; seen.add((i, j))
                while q:
                    y, x = q.popleft(); comp.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == c and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                comps.append((c, comp))
    return comps

def fill_bbox(grid, comp, color):
    """New grid with the bounding box of a component filled with color."""
    ys = [p[0] for p in comp]; xs = [p[1] for p in comp]
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y in range(min(ys), max(ys) + 1):
        for x in range(min(xs), max(xs) + 1):
            g[y][x] = color
    return g

def denoise_shapes(grid):
    """Remove scattered noise cells, keeping solid shapes; noise inside a shape's bounding box is recolored to the shape's color."""
    bg = background(grid)
    out = [[bg] * len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    cs = components(grid, bg=bg)
    cs = [(c, comp) for c, comp in cs if len(comp) > 1]
    for c, comp in cs:
        out = fill_bbox(out, comp, c)
    return out
'''
